hana-devex: Quick report from the next-starter cleanup: sample fails for new users when embeddings + chat streams run concurrently. Repro and proposed fix below.

omar-frontend: Thanks, what's the exact failure users see?

hana-devex: Two user-visible problems: (1) ephemeral token flows sometimes surface a 401 in the browser SDK and stop, while Python retries transparently; (2) when embeddings.request() and chat.stream() run at the same time the chat UI often shows no incremental tokens even though network shows chunked responses.

lucas-ml: Do you have a minimal repro?

hana-devex: Yep, sample code does: const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: RW_KEY, retry: { retries: 1 } }); const emb = c.embeddings.create({ model: 'redwood/embed-small', input }); const stream = await c.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood/mini-stream', input: prompt }); for await (const p of stream) append(p.text || p); // sometimes nothing until final

omar-frontend: The 401 behavior sounds like our browser bundle flags 401 as terminal. And the stream issue smells like the SDK's stream helper reassembling decoder chunks differently in bundled polyfills.

lucas-ml: Agreed. Short-term sample fix ideas: - set retry.authRetry: true in client init for the sample (comment why) - serialize streaming calls: await emb before starting chat OR clone response streams - include a small TextDecoder pump shim using stream.raw: true so the demo shows incremental tokens on Edge/Vercel

ivy-docs: For onboarding we want the demo to "just work". Please also add a README section "Dev token races & streaming" with the workaround and a one-liner to revert when SDK patch is released.

hana-devex: I'll make a tiny sample PR that: 1) updates client init to { retries:1, authRetry:true } with comment; 2) sequences embeddings before chat by default; 3) uses a short raw-stream shim with TextDecoder and shows how to flip to SDK stream granularity when available.

omar-frontend: For the SDK we should only add opt-ins. Propose adding retry.authRetry:boolean and stream.raw:boolean (or granularity option). Default behavior remains unchanged. We'll ship as experimental in a patch.

lucas-ml: Also add integration tests in the eval harness that mock: a) 401 then 200 for auth flow, b) token-sized vs aggregated chunks for stream framing. This will prevent regressions.

ci-bot: [ci] queued job 33901: examples/next-starter smoke test

ivy-docs: I'll update README and add a short FAQ entry. New users running Vercel previews are the main callers of this bug.

hana-devex: Opening PRs now: INF-11012 (sample: sequencing + raw shim + docs) and INF-11013 (SDK: opt-ins + tests). Will ping reviewers. Thanks all :pray:

omar-frontend: Great, ping me on PRs and I'll review the sample changes.

lucas-ml: I'll add the harness mocks for streaming chunks and auth retry simulation.

hana-devex: Posting the small shim snippet here for the sample to copy: const reader = response.body.getReader(); const dec = new TextDecoder(); let buf=''; while(true){ const {done, value}=await reader.read(); if(done) break; buf += dec.decode(value, {stream:true}); processFragments(buf); } processFragments(buf, {final:true});

ivy-docs: Perfect. Add that in a fenced snippet in README and mention it's safe to remove when SDK adds stream.raw or token granularity.
